You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: How many days of maternity leave are available to a GitLab employee in the Philippines?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): Up to 105 days, with an option for 30 additional unpaid days (45 extra days for solo mothers).

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Italy 🇮🇹**]
If eligible, a team member's first 16 weeks of leave will be supplemented the remaining 20% per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

**Applying for Maternity Leave in Italy**

To initiate your parental leave, submit your time off by selecting the Parental Leave category in Workday at least 30 days before your leave starts. Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**Paternity Leave**

Below is the information related to Italy's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Italy are hired via Remote (PEO) and you should always check with Remote first for the most up to date information.

Fathers are also obligated to take a seven-day paid leave of absence from work during the five months of maternity leave. The mother has the option to extend the father's paternal leave if she transfers one of her maternity days to him.

If eligible, team members can take up to 16 weeks of time away (in total) per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

[Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > **Philippines 🇵🇭**]
- **Maternity:** Up to 105 days, with option for 30 additional unpaid days (45 extra days for solo mothers)
- **Paternity:** Up to 7 days, extendable to 14 days if spouse allocates additional days
- **Payment:** Social Security System provides base payments; GitLab supplements to 100% for up to 16 weeks if eligible
- Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**How to Apply**
Submit requests via [Workday - Time Off](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZatJdGp485lOS2QVrxYJByQK8dD_CMGiLVOykgd338w/edit) at least 30 days before leave starts.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave category) 30+ days before start
- Send [MATB1 Certificate](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/maternity-certificate-mat-b1-guidance-for-health-professionals/ee03eb40-34b3-4930-8715-9cab858421ef) to leaves@gitlab.com at least 21 days before leave
- The Absence Management team will then complete a [Risk Assessment Form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qHdbaeFSnqdwkQDTEurHD5QMbLPLuZGBQO_CBnRkpiE/edit) within 1-3 days of receiving notification of your leave. The purpose of the assessment is to make the team member aware of any hazards or "risks" to her in the workplace/home office to reduce potential injury to her or her baby.
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the MATB1, start date of leave, and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc). Payroll will then automatically calculate the SMP due each pay period based on this information. The recovery of 90% will be outlined on the monthly payroll spreadsheet so that the finance team has indication of the amounts being offset each month.
- Payroll will continue to be the same while on parental leave but Vistra will file for reimbursement of any statutory funds once the proper paperwork has been sent. If you do not qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay, you may qualify for [Maternity Allowance](https://www.gov.uk/maternity-allowance).
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
Based on the context provided for the Philippines, a GitLab employee is available **up to 105 days** of maternity leave, with the option for **30 additional unpaid days** (or **45 extra days** for solo mothers).
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
